description: Authenticated Control1 planning produces evidence-bound retained non-executable previews while preserving authoritative Linux state.

steps.name: control1-plan-preview-is-non-executable
steps.command:
command -v linurad >/dev/null && command -v linuractl >/dev/null && command -v dbus-run-session >/dev/null && command -v systemctl >/dev/null && sudo -n true && dbus-run-session -- bash -euo pipefail -c 'daemon=; unit=linura-plan-preview-acceptance-$$.service; unit_path=/run/systemd/system/$unit; resource=systemd:unit:$unit; cleanup() { if [[ -n "$daemon" ]]; then kill "$daemon" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$daemon" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; sudo -n systemctl stop "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sudo -n rm -f "$unit_path"; sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; printf "[Unit]
Description=Linura plan preview acceptance fixture
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/true
RemainAfterExit=yes
" | sudo -n tee "$unit_path" >/dev/null; sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload; native_before=$(systemctl show "$unit" --property=ActiveState --value); [[ "$native_before" == inactive ]]; linurad >/tmp/linurad-plan-acceptance.log 2>&1 & daemon=$!; ready=0; for _ in $(seq 1 50); do if linuractl capabilities >/tmp/linura-plan-capabilities 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; if [[ "$ready" -ne 1 ]]; then cat /tmp/linurad-plan-acceptance.log >&2; exit 1; fi; linuractl whoami >/tmp/linura-plan-whoami; grep -F "uid=$(id -u)" /tmp/linura-plan-whoami; grep -F "actor_kind=service" /tmp/linura-plan-whoami; grep -F "provider=systemd" /tmp/linura-plan-capabilities; grep -F "capability=systemd.unit.observe" /tmp/linura-plan-capabilities; first=$(linuractl plan-preview request:vm-change "$resource" "activate acceptance fixture" --intent intent:vm-plan --set active_state=active); grep -F "plan_id=request:vm-change" <<<"$first"; grep -F "request_id=request:vm-change" <<<"$first"; grep -F "provider=systemd" <<<"$first"; grep -F "resource=$resource" <<<"$first"; grep -F "capability=systemd.unit.observe" <<<"$first"; first_evidence=$(sed -n "s/^evidence_id=//p" <<<"$first"); [[ -n "$first_evidence" ]]; grep -F "prospective_risk=system-mutation" <<<"$first"; grep -F "status=change-proposed" <<<"$first"; grep -F "execution_authorized=false" <<<"$first"; grep -F "change.0.key=active_state" <<<"$first"; grep -F "change.0.current_present=true" <<<"$first"; grep -F "change.0.current=inactive" <<<"$first"; grep -F "change.0.desired=active" <<<"$first"; review=$(linuractl review-plan request:vm-change); grep -F "plan_id=request:vm-change" <<<"$review"; grep -F "principal=unix:uid:$(id -u)" <<<"$review"; grep -F "planner_risk_floor=system-mutation" <<<"$review"; grep -F "reviewed_risk=security-sensitive" <<<"$review"; grep -F "status=change-proposed" <<<"$review"; grep -F "policy_id=policy:baseline" <<<"$review"; grep -F "policy_revision_id=policy:baseline:v1" <<<"$review"; grep -F "decision=require-approval" <<<"$review"; grep -F "approval_required=true" <<<"$review"; grep -F "approval_class=administrator" <<<"$review"; grep -F "execution_authorized=false" <<<"$review"; grep -F "reason.summary=activate acceptance fixture" <<<"$review"; grep -F "reason.intent.0=intent:vm-plan" <<<"$review"; grep -F "authority-risk-classified" <<<"$review"; review_retry=$(linuractl review-plan request:vm-change); [[ "$review_retry" == "$review" ]]; review_explained=$(linuractl explain-plan-review request:vm-change); [[ "$review_explained" == "$review" ]]; retry=$(linuractl plan-preview request:vm-change "$resource" "activate acceptance fixture" --intent intent:vm-plan --set active_state=active); [[ "$retry" == "$first" ]]; retained=$(linuractl get-plan-preview request:vm-change); [[ "$retained" == "$first" ]]; explained=$(linuractl explain-plan-preview request:vm-change); [[ "$explained" == "$first" ]]; current_explanation=$(linuractl explain "$resource"); current_evidence=$(sed -n "s/^evidence_id=//p" <<<"$current_explanation"); [[ "$current_evidence" == "$first_evidence" ]]; native_after_preview=$(systemctl show "$unit" --property=ActiveState --value); [[ "$native_after_preview" == inactive ]]; observed_after_preview=$(linuractl observe "$resource"); grep -F "attribute.active_state=inactive" <<<"$observed_after_preview"; native_after_observe=$(systemctl show "$unit" --property=ActiveState --value); [[ "$native_after_observe" == inactive ]]; nochange=$(linuractl plan-preview request:vm-nochange "$resource" "keep acceptance fixture inactive" --intent intent:vm-plan --set active_state=inactive); grep -F "status=no-change" <<<"$nochange"; grep -F "prospective_risk=read-only" <<<"$nochange"; grep -F "execution_authorized=false" <<<"$nochange"; if grep -F "change.0." <<<"$nochange" >/dev/null; then echo "no-change preview unexpectedly contains a change" >&2; exit 1; fi; blocked=$(linuractl plan-preview request:vm-blocked "$resource" "require unobserved state" --intent intent:vm-plan --set unobserved_state=desired); grep -F "status=blocked" <<<"$blocked"; grep -F "prospective_risk=system-mutation" <<<"$blocked"; grep -F "execution_authorized=false" <<<"$blocked"; grep -F "=attribute-not-observed" <<<"$blocked"; blocked_review=$(linuractl review-plan request:vm-blocked); grep -F "decision=blocked" <<<"$blocked_review"; grep -F "approval_required=false" <<<"$blocked_review"; grep -F "execution_authorized=false" <<<"$blocked_review"; if grep -F "approval_class=" <<<"$blocked_review" >/dev/null; then echo "blocked review unexpectedly carries approval class" >&2; exit 1; fi; pre_conflict=$(linuractl explain "$resource"); pre_conflict_evidence=$(sed -n "s/^evidence_id=//p" <<<"$pre_conflict"); [[ -n "$pre_conflict_evidence" ]]; if linuractl plan-preview request:vm-change "$resource" "activate acceptance fixture" --intent intent:vm-plan --set active_state=inactive >/tmp/linura-plan-conflict.out 2>/tmp/linura-plan-conflict.err; then echo "conflicting request id unexpectedly succeeded" >&2; exit 1; fi; grep -F "different normalized request" /tmp/linura-plan-conflict.err; post_conflict=$(linuractl explain "$resource"); post_conflict_evidence=$(sed -n "s/^evidence_id=//p" <<<"$post_conflict"); [[ "$post_conflict_evidence" == "$pre_conflict_evidence" ]]; native_final=$(systemctl show "$unit" --property=ActiveState --value); [[ "$native_final" == inactive ]]'
